combinations.readout: H3K9ac protein level in astroglial (C6) cells
combinations.magnitude: CGRP-induced H3K9ac increase partially or completely blocked
combinations.evidence_quote: However, CGRP with AA (HATs inhibitor) partially or completely blocked the increased effect of CGRP on the expression of H3K9ac (Figure 4C).

combinations.magnitude: CGRP-induced proliferation partially or completely blocked (p<0.05); CGRP8-37 (2 μM) also blocked
combinations.evidence_quote: Compared with CGRP alone, CGRP with AA or CGRP8‐37 partially or completely blocked the increased effect of CGRP on cell proliferation and viability after 20‐h treatment (p < 0.05; n = 3).

combinations.readout: CX3CR1, LC3B and IL-1β protein in astroglial cells
combinations.magnitude: CGRP-induced increase partially or completely blocked (p<0.05)
combinations.evidence_quote: However, CGRP with AA partially or completely blocked the increased effect of CGRP on the expression of CX3CR1, LC3B (Figure 6D), and IL‐1β (Figure 6E) in astroglial cells after 4‐h treatment (p < 0.05; n = 4).
